entry_state: Engineering conformance,accounting validity and scientific forecasting require separate evidence. Core cases include balanced-but-wrong counterexamples and preserve unsupported outcomes. The DSL comparator uses the same typed IR and tasks. Forecast comparisons require equal information,uncertainty and retained failed predictions. The nine-issuer corpus is developmental;192 reports are not independent and exact-byte availability remains required. E1 evaluates source preservation,E2 bounded reconstruction and conditional accounting. E3 introduces first-release operating cash flow and a joint secondary vector;its comparator discussion continues after360.
exit_state: E3 defines proper-score comparisons,as-of scaling,full eligibility denominators and paired uncertainty before ranking. E4 requires credit cohorts or claims triangles;E5 checks inference targets before speed;E6 compares matched authoring and admitted reuse. The budget ladder separates exact checks,development,retrospective and new heldout evidence. Joined accounting calculations retain these distinct targets. Sector capabilities and P0–P6 are a proposed dependency order,not executed product phases. Section14.10 begins366 with limited conformance oracles and the distinction between192 acquired report slots and complete disclosure packages.

findings.observation: The protocols retain missing predictions and distinguish exact target failure,candidate rejection and insufficient evidence for ranking.
Joined validation reactivates actual sector examples and rejects substitution of contractual,expected and measured amounts despite a balanced group statement.
Implementation milestones preserve the narrow matched text frontend and explicitly require completion of the proposal before implementation authorization.
